definitions.explanation: A flooded field where rice is cultivated.

examples.japanese: {稲田|いなだ}に{水|みず}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: I flood the rice paddy with water.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{稲田|いなだ}が{黄金色|こがねいろ}に{染|そ}まる。
examples.english: In autumn, the rice paddies turn golden.

examples.japanese: {村|むら}の{周|まわ}りには{見渡|みわた}す{限|かぎ}り{稲田|いなだ}が{続|つづ}いていた。
examples.english: Rice paddies stretched as far as the eye could see around the village.

notes:
{稲田|いなだ} is a somewhat literary or formal word for rice paddy. In everyday conversation, {田|た}んぼ or {水田|すいでん} are more commonly used. {稲田|いなだ} emphasizes the paddy as a field of rice plants ({稲|いね}) and is often found in written descriptions of rural scenery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {稲田|いなだ}の{風景|ふうけい} — rice paddy scenery
- {青々|あおあお}とした{稲田|いなだ} — verdant rice paddies
- {稲田|いなだ}が{実|みの}る — the rice paddy bears grain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {田|た}んぼ — rice paddy (everyday, spoken)
- {水田|すいでん} — paddy field (neutral, common in writing)
- {田畑|たはた} — fields (rice paddies and dry fields collectively)

NOTE: {稲田|いなだ} is also a common Japanese surname.
